ns2:section.sectionText: This on-line course has one required class meeting: last class/national certification exam on March 9. Registration restricted to dietetics and hospitality management majors only. Seats will be open to all FSHN majors and minors (minors must contact the department office (333-1324) for authorization to register) at the beginning of sophomore registration. Any remaining seats will be released to the general student population at the beginning of freshman registration. If you get a 'course full' error message and want to be added to a wait list for this class, go to www.fshn.illinois.edu and click on Undergraduate then Admissions then Course Wait List. Wait lists will not open until one week before classes start in January. Until that time, it is up to you to continue to check the status of this course to see if a seat has become available for you.
